sources.title: Datasets - Research Group CAMMA
sources.snippet: The official data splits for research and development of deep learning models on the CholecT50/CholecT45 datasets are described in: C.I. Nwoye, N. Padoy, Data Splits and Metrics for Benchmarking Methods on Surgical Action Triplet Datasets, arXiv preprint, 2022. The data was used in the CholecTriplet2021 and CholecTriplet2022 challenges.

sources.title: CholecT50: Fine-Grained Laparoscopic Triplet Dataset
sources.snippet: CholecT50 is a fine-grained laparoscopic cholecystectomy dataset with 50 videos that enables detailed surgical workflow analysis using action triplets.
